key.name: font
key.description: Font family for the key glyphs. Empty uses IBM Plex Sans when it is installed and the system interface font otherwise.

key.name: fkeys
key.description: Maps a function-row slot (f1-f12) to a standard function id. A slot with no entry taps its default function key.

key.name: active-color
key.description: Hex colour of a one-shot or locked modifier. Empty follows the system accent colour (blue on GNOME 46).

key.name: case
key.description: Case applied to the static key faces (Esc, Tab, Ctrl). The F in F1-F12 always stays uppercase; typed glyphs follow the active layout.

key.name: layout
key.description: Which key block to draw: a 60% compact block, the default 75% block with the function row, navigation column and arrow cluster, or a 100% full block that adds the numpad.

key.name: height
key.description: Keyboard height as a percent of the shorter display edge.

key.name: spacing
key.description: Gap between keys as a percent of the default gap.

key.name: glyph-size
key.description: Font size of the key glyphs as a percent of the default.

key.name: style
key.description: Modern is flat and follows the system light or dark scheme. Classic is the original dark look with shaded keys.

key.name: corner
key.description: Roundness of the key corners. Sharp is nearly square, soft is the default, round has the largest radius.

key.name: rounded
key.description: Whether the keyboard's top corners are rounded.

key.name: modifier-mode
key.description: How the modifier keys (Shift, Ctrl, Alt, Super, AltGr) and Fn respond to a tap. Hold: a quick tap is one real keystroke and a long press locks. Latch: a tap arms the next keystroke only and a double tap locks. Toggle: every tap flips a lock.

key.name: accents
key.description: Whether a long press on a Latin letter opens a popup of accented variants. When off, every key repeats on hold instead.

key.name: click-enabled
key.description: Whether tapping a key plays a short click. The click is synthesised and routed through the shell's event-sound channel, so a system mute of event sounds silences it too.

key.name: click-sound
key.description: Which synthesised click to play: thock (soft, deep and muted), click (crisp, clean and short) or tap (warm, round and woody).

key.name: click-volume
key.description: Loudness of the key click as a percent of full scale.
